title: PayloadFrame
description: Transport envelope for framed Socket.IO events, including registration, capabilities, heartbeat, RPC, ACKs and streaming. Hub control events agent:register_error and agent:session.superseded use plain JSON instead; connection:ready is informational and is not consumed by the current agent runtime.

schemaVersion.description: Frame schema version (e.g. '1.0'). Receivers must reject unknown major versions.

enc.description: Encoding of the logical payload before compression. The current runtime supports JSON UTF-8 only.

cmp.description: Compression algorithm applied to the encoded payload. 'none' means no compression.

contentType.description: MIME type of the original (uncompressed, decoded) payload. Always 'application/json' under the current contract; the 'enc' enum is restricted to 'json'.

originalSize.description: Size in bytes of the payload before compression (equals compressedSize when cmp='none').

compressedSize.description: Size in bytes of the payload after compression.

payload.description: Encoded JSON UTF-8 bytes, optionally compressed. Socket.IO transports them as a binary attachment; equivalent base64 strings are accepted. Raw structured logical JSON is not a supported frame payload.

traceId.description: Optional trace ID for distributed tracing correlation.

requestId.description: Optional request ID matching the JSON-RPC 'id' of the contained request or response.

signature.description: Optional HMAC transport-level signature for payload integrity verification.

key_id.description: Identifier of the signing key used to produce the signature.
